Grain Handler
Employment Basis: Full-Time

Specific Task
•	Operate specialize Kotzur bulk grain handling circuit to use for the receival, storage, transfer, packing, and dispatch of grain products.
•	Conduct detailed inspection of equipment, check and record any faults and rectified before operation (refer to maintenance schedule procedure).
•	Reference should be given to risk assessment of bucket elevator operation. Paying particular attention to that all safety guards and equipment are installed (refer to risk assessment).
•	Before putting drag conveyor into operation, ensure foreign material is removed from drag conveyor.
•	Ensure close all boots and inspection panels and ensure drive guards are in place.
•	Start conveyor motor and listen carefully if any abnormal noises before operation.
•	Conveyors should not be operated unless they are completely enclosed, and power transmission guards are in place.
•	Follow inspections schedule to ensure the equipment is in good operating condition.
•	Inspect chain, paddles, transmission v-belts.
•	Check chain tension, gearbox, bearing, all sheave drive and attaching parts, check all hardware, and check chain carrier tracks.
•	As per WHS requirements tests E-stops, control panels (refer to risk assessment operation).
•	Once bulk grain handling circuit is safe to operate, proceed to the test running the circuit with no grain.
•	Proceed to control room and test container inverter weight scales are reading correctly.
•	Carry out visual inspection of individual weight scales, frames, wiring are safe to operate.
•	Ensure twist locks on both inverter 1 and 2 are operating correctly.
•	Inspect and grease cylinders, pivot points and check safety guards are operating correctly.
•	Ensure area is clear of any obstacles (shovels, brooms, grains, water, etc) to move any trip hazard while loading.
•	Check fumigation clearance has been approved, and the area is safe.
•	Coordinate with export team members to ensure packing can commence.

General Task
•	Clean, repair as required and inspect containers to meet the standards of food quality of Department of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Forestry.
